subject: CSA coverage heatmap & artifact capture sprint
messages:
From: Carolyn Lee <carolyn@harborcare.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@harborcare.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:23:00 -0800
Subject: Request: CSA control coverage heatmap + artifact list

Hi Mina / Marissa,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. HarborCare is proceeding with our vendor review and we need a compact deliverable to feed into our internal CSA (CAIQ) review. Specifically we need:

- A control coverage heatmap aligned to CSA controls (indicate "Covered / Partially Covered / Not Applicable")
- A short artifact list that maps to the controls (e.g., config snapshot, runbook excerpt, audit log sample)
- A proposed intake cadence so our audit team can pull samples (dates/time window)

Can you provide a proposed timeline and a single-sheet heatmap template we can use? Ideally we want the heatmap + artifact list within two business weeks. Please note HarborCare's legal team also wants to scope an NDA before sharing a deeper evidence bundle (DocuSign ok).

Attachments: harborcare_csa_questions_v1.pdf (external questionnaire, 12 pages)

Thanks,
Carolyn Lee
Vendor Risk Manager
HarborCare Health
carolyn@harborcare.com
---
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Carolyn Lee <carolyn@harborcare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: CSA control coverage heatmap + artifact list

Hi Carolyn — thanks for the clear ask and the questionnaire. We can do the heatmap + artifact list within the 2-week window you requested. Proposed plan below.

Plan (summary):
- Day 0 (today): Confirm scoping controls (we'll mark controls in-scope vs not-applicable)
- Days 1-3: Redwood composes single-sheet CSA heatmap + artifact index (owner + artifact type + redaction notes)
- Days 4-8: Internal evidence collection sprint (samples prepared by owners)
- Day 9: Deliver draft heatmap + artifact list for HarborCare review
- Day 10-12: Address clarifying questions and provide one redaction-friendly sample per control

Owners (internal):
- Mina Haddad: control mapping lead; final review
- Marissa Cole: evidence orchestration and artifact bundles
- Ben Carter: runtime/log sample extraction and annotations

Deliverables we will attach: redwood_csa_heatmap_template.xlsx (template), redwood_evidence_capture_sprint_plan.pdf (timeline + owner tasks). We will not transmit full logs until NDA is in place; we can provide redaction-friendly samples and config screenshots in the first pass.

Can you please: 1) confirm the scope (full CSA or only selected families), and 2) share the DocuSign NDA link when ready so we can coordinate the evidence transfer window?

Best,
Mina Haddad
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

On Fri, Nov 13, 2026 at 9:04 AM Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Can you please: 1) confirm the scope (full CSA or only selected families), and 2) share the DocuSign NDA link when ready so we can coordinate the evidence transfer window?

Hi Carolyn — quick follow up from our side. For speed we've prepared a heatmap template and an evidence capture checklist (see attachments). Proposed scope options:

Option A (recommended): Full CSA families but focus on controls that touch inference runtime, key management, and telemetry. This maps to ~45 controls in our initial pass.
Option B (narrow): Only families: Configuration Management, Logging & Monitoring, Cryptography, Identity & Access. (~18 controls).

If HarborCare chooses Option A we'll deliver the full heatmap with a short artifact index and 1 sample artifact per control (redacted). If Option B we'll front-load the highest-risk artifacts.

Attachments (for draft handoff): redwood_csa_heatmap_template.xlsx, redwood_evidence_capture_sprint_plan.pdf

Related links: Drive folder for exchange: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cHeatmapRepo
HubSpot record: HS-2026-7783

Marissa Cole
Senior Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks Mina/Marissa — this looks good. HarborCare will proceed with Option A (full CSA focus on runtime/keys/telemetry). A couple of quick notes:

- NDA: here's the DocuSign link (internal legal routed): https://www.docusign.com/agreements/XYZ-nda-4343

- Contact for deep tech pulls: James Ortega (security@harborcare.com) — he'll coordinate log replay requests if necessary.

We look forward to the draft heatmap.

Best,
Carolyn Lee
